objective: Next source grasp/lift while the already placed lower prefix remains continuously valid; validate full towers separately

pilot.completion_labels: original only; shared hidden layers can still drift
pilot.selection: development only, parent at update0 eligible, earlier checkpoint wins exact tie
pilot.paired_sampler: all frame ids and optimizer settings identical across B0/B; only new-pool loss weights differ
pilot.sampling: available phase -> episode -> section -> frame, no quality oversampling
pilot.resume: no automatic resume or retry; preserve outputs, explicit audited restore only

score.preservation: preservation/contact-freedom are strict gates; preservation term is constant .5, actual quality variation is only quietness/centering

events.action_window: first action after release event through confirmed pickup; later50 frames only outcome metadata
events.terminal_or_interrupted: reject censored and structurally damaged transitions; classify reasons
events.historical_contact_flags: invalid dictionary semantics: never acceptable as verified native contacts

gates.threshold_status: predeclared pilot engineering gates, not universal scientific constants

collection.mode: new native collection required before production
collection.split: first160 train,last40 valid; one cyclic teacher per attempt, outcomes never alter assignment
collection.teacher_source: three listed parents; no teacher chosen using historical heldout wins
collection.family: namespace+height+seed; all branches inherit same split
collection.storage: pre/post state, synchronized pre/post observations, native held, all finger contacts, corrected strict-prefix metrics, policy/controller state, per-frame logging; no new expert actions

evaluation.primary: joint native-grasp/lift AND continuously valid lower prefix; not contact/lift proxy
evaluation.prepared: synchronized native state AND phase/steps/anchor/stage/retreat/controller state; deterministic first-step replay equality before using benchmark
evaluation.full_rollout: no teleports, same corrected metric/controller for all arms
evaluation.statistics: paired starts, every training seed, paired uncertainty; no pooled independent300 claim
evaluation.promotion: development improvement >=5 percentage points in each prepared-prefix stratum, confirmed on disjoint development, at least2/3 seeds; no more than5pp lower-height regression; descriptive pilot decision only
evaluation.heldout: freeze all selected checkpoints before once-only tests, do not optimize from them

budget.note: upper bound proposal, no run started; activate explicit UTC deadline before any full collection/train, supervisor required

source_allowlist.purpose: historical audit/proxy inventory only, not verified native production data
historical audit/proxy inventory only, not verified native production data

blocked_until: new synchronized native collection frozen with family splits
independent online evaluator and checkpoint selection implemented and tested
